title: Python sandbox should return structured stdout so typed outputs read real values
Refine Agent A system prompt
description: Streamline Agent A system prompt: trim architecture section, remove DB schema, merge responsibilities/guidance, reorder tools/contract, and expand prior conversation context (5 entries, ordered newest first with cycle IDs/timestamps using clean Agent A intent wording and hydrated narration text only).

title: Log failed cycles separately
notes: Implemented cycle_failures table + migrations, added Memory.record_cycle_failure/getter, wired orchestrator to log on errors, and covered with tests/docs.

title: Fix Agent A response-type return indentation
notes: Agent A direct-response return block sits outside its if clause; execution-plan responses hit UnboundLocalError. Need to re-indent and add regression test.

title: Agent A single system prompt
description: Ensure AGENT_A_SYSTEM_PROMPT stays the sole prompt for planning + narration, and polish direct-response fallbacks if regressions appear.

title: Persist planner responses to chat history
description: Currently we only call memory.save_chat_exchange() for Agent A direct-response cycles. Planner executions that run Agent B and produce ToolExecutor outputs never store their final narration, so chat_history lacks the majority of user interactions and Agent A cannot use past answers for context. Fix: after a successful planner run (once narration template is rendered), save the query + final Agent A narration into chat_history just like we do for direct responses. Ensure this runs inside the success path so failed cycles still skip persistence.

title: Typed outputs for Agent A narration
Planner must embed user inputs in steps
description: Agent A currently emits bland intents (e.g., 'Count every alphabetic character in the string') without carrying its inferred interpretation of the user request into each step. Without that richer intent text, Agent B lacks enough guidance to reconstruct the user's actual goal. Fix plan: tighten Agent A's system prompt + plan validator so each step's intent/description explicitly states the inferred objective (e.g., 'Count letters in "this is a test, just for Agent A"'), ensuring Agent B can operate on the right data.

title: Agent A prompt lacks tool descriptions; risk of invalid plans
description: Expand Agent A planner prompt with explicit tool descriptions, natural-language intent guidance, and illustrative intent examples so plans stay valid.

title: Agent A fallback for unclear intent
description: Augment Agent A system prompt with clarification guidance: if intent cannot be inferred from current query, reuse up to two most recent user queries/responses for context; if still unclear, explicitly ask user for clarification.

title: REPL overhaul for v1.5 spec
description:
Ground-up REPL rewrite per ai_terminal_spec_v1.5: drop Rich panel wrapper, drive single-line status indicator, and render narration as plain text with optional fenced blocks only; placeholders map to inline text for scalars and fenced blocks for structured outputs. Implementation plan:
1. Replace current render_cycle/Main loop so each cycle prints user query + final response without nested panels; keep Cycle ID bottom-right as plain text.
2. Rebuild narration composer to walk response_segments, treating placeholders according to output_value_types (text vs. block) and only pulling stdout metadata when a block needs it.
3. Implement block helpers for plan/bash/output/json/md/log and ensure ANSI formatting stays inside fences.
4. Add snapshot-style tests for renderer output and rerun orchestrator/formatter suites.
